==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|second-hand|second hand|secondhanded|second-handed|2ndhand}}

===Etymology===
From {{com|en|second|hand}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˌsɛk(ə)n(d)ˈhænd/|/ˈsɛk(ə)n(d)ˌhænd/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-second-hand.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-secondhand.oga|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ænd|s=3}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj|-}}

# {{lb|en|of goods}} Not [[new]]; [[previously]] [[owned]] and [[used]] by another.
#: {{synonyms|en|used|preloved<q:euphemistic>|pre-owned|hand-me-down}}
# {{lb|en|of a dealer}} [[dealing|Dealing]] in such [[merchandise]].
# {{lb|en|figurative}} [[indirect|Indirect]]; from a [[secondary]] source; not [[firsthand]].
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1949|author={{w|Friedrich Hayek|F. A. Hayek}}|title=The Intellectuals and Socialism|journal={{w|University of Chicago Law Review}}|publisher={{w|University of Chicago}}|location={{w|Chicago}}|volume=16|number=3|doi=10.2307/1597903|page=417|passage=In the light of recent history it is somewhat curious that this decisive power of the professional '''secondhand''' dealers in ideas should not yet be more generally recognized.}}
# {{lb|en|of cigarette or cigar smoke}} [[inhale|Inhale]]d from the [[air]] near someone else [[smoking]].
#: {{ux|en|exposure to '''secondhand''' smoke from cigarette-smoking colleagues}}
